Pack: load 2.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[3,6]]]*/const D={"L_p3":"[[528,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf3\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aoyama's earlier secrets hold as history: born Quirkless, Navel Laser given by All For One, orders through his parents, and this summer, under orders, the location of the training camp the League of Villains attacked; Katsuki Bakugo was taken and rescued at Kamino, where the country watched All Might, his hero form gone to a gaunt, wounded man, beat All For One, who is now in custody; All Might retired. U.A.'s faculty suspect the location leaked; nobody at U.A. knows it was Yuga.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"If the story has played it, he has left cheese for Izuku Midoriya and told him their Quirks do not suit their bodies; Izuku took it as an odd kindness. Yuga suspects that Izuku's power, too, was not born with him, and tells no one. Whether he ever named Izuku to his master canon does not show; keep it unsaid unless the story needs it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"For the rest of the year he lives with it: no new orders while his master is held, unless the story sends some through his parents; a dread that does not lift; guilt that grows with every kindness from 1-A. He is exposed only if the story builds it, through investigation (Principal Nezu is the likeliest to piece it together) or his own confession. Exposed, canon has him break down, confess everything and beg for his parents' safety; he wants to make amends, not to escape. Until then, play the record: sparkle, riddles and loneliness behind the act; any fear shows rarely and unexplained, never proof.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf3\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[529,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Minoru Mineta (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf4\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kamino as the whole country saw it live (narrator only; the record says only that All Might retired). All Might's muscular form gave out mid-battle, and the cameras showed a gaunt, hollow-cheeked man who still defeated the villain who stood behind the League of Villains; that villain was arrested, and All Might retired. Since then All Might has appeared at U.A. only in that gaunt form. Mineta knows only what the broadcast and the news showed. He knows nothing of One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it, the old wound behind All Might's decline, Yuga Aoyama's betrayal, Hawks' double role or Dabi's identity. Canon leaves unclear how much of that villain's name (All For One) and history reached the public; give Mineta no more than the broadcast showed.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf4\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[530,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Minoru Mineta (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf5\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kamino as the whole country saw it live (narrator only; his record does not describe it). All Might's muscular form gave out mid-battle, and the cameras showed a gaunt, hollow-cheeked man who still defeated the villain who stood behind the League of Villains; that villain was arrested, and All Might retired. By now Mineta is used to seeing All Might around U.A. in that gaunt form. He knows only what the broadcast and the news showed: nothing of One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it, the old wound behind All Might's decline, Yuga Aoyama's betrayal, Hawks' double role or Dabi's identity, and no more of that villain (All For One) than the broadcast showed.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf5\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[531,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Mina Ashido (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf6\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). The battle at Kamino went out live, and the whole country, Mina included, saw All Might's hero form give out mid-fight into a gaunt, wounded man before he won; he retired soon after and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record says only that his last fight ended his career, and she knows only what the broadcast showed: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it. The villain he beat there, All For One, the League's backer, is in custody; she knows him only as the villain in the broadcast, and how much more the public learns is for the story.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf6\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[532,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Mina Ashido (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf7\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). Since the live Kamino broadcast, Mina, like the whole country, has seen All Might's hero form give out into a gaunt, wounded man in his last fight; he has retired and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record leaves Kamino out. She knows what the broadcast showed and nothing more: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it. She knows the villain he beat there (All For One, the League's backer) only as the villain in the broadcast. This holds for the rest of the year unless the story tells her more.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf7\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[533,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Toru Hagakure (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf8\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret).
